reason: Derived data: ancestor/descendant pairs of today's tree, recomputed from org_unit_version (rebuilt wholesale by the seed and the daily refresh). Every change it reflects is already audited on org_unit_version (docs/contracts/audit.md › Coverage).

Derived, high-volume data (docs/contracts/notifications.md): one row per recipient of an event that is already audited — the workflow_task / workflow_instance / leave_request row changes and the workflow.* application events. Its only change after insert is read_at (marking read, a per-user UI state, guarded by a trigger); old read rows are purged by the worker's notifications.cleanup job.
